name: injection_fake
expected: an invalid label never reaches a record (enum check); a review whose output is invalid twice is quarantined with its reason; an answer for an unsent review is rejected (whole call unusable → bisected until the culprit is alone); quotes are cut by code, never taken from the model; the other reviews complete

name: group_memo_injection
expected: the invented issue name is dropped; the memo with an unknown issue/review ID and an unsupported number fails the code check, is retried once with the errors, and only the clean answer is written

name: malformed_output
expected: a non-JSON response fails the call, which is bisected and re-sent (no review charged an invalid attempt for it); a review missing from the answer twice is quarantined with reason and attempt count in outputs/quarantine.jsonl; every other review completes

name: missing_text
expected: empty / whitespace-only texts are quarantined at intake with reason 'empty_review_text' and never sent to a model; the rest complete

name: ambiguous_label
expected: low-confidence (ambiguous) reviews still get one valid label; every probability is saved with the decision (agent_outputs A3); under the frozen config only severity is escalated, so a low topic probability does not by itself set needs_review (known limitation, golden recall 15%)

name: transient_failures
expected: 429 / 408 are retried with backoff (429 not charged, 408 settled at the estimate) and the queue drains; 402 stops everything with no lease left and resume finishes; 400 stops the run; an item failing 3 times (max_attempts) is marked failed, not retried forever

name: spend_controls
expected: the ledger reserves before every call and stops admitting work before the cap (spent ≤ cap, nothing left reserved); a paid provider without --paid/--max-spend is refused; a fake run on state/pipeline.db is refused

name: hard_kill_recovery
expected: a run killed with no cleanup is detected as crashed once its heartbeat is stale; its in-flight call is closed as failed and settled at the estimate; resume finishes the queue without re-sending any completed ID (checker resume rules pass)

name: real_transient_failures
